summary.title: How To Launch Your Own Production-ready Cryptocurrency
summary.one_liner: You learn how to build an ERC-20 token on Ethereum with Solidity and Truffle, test it, deploy it to the Ropsten test network, and add a web-based crowdsale with Web3.js.
takeaways: Build a fixed-supply ERC-20 token in Solidity (default 1 billion tokens, 18 decimals) using Truffle and OpenZeppelin.
Write and run integration tests with truffle develop on a local test blockchain with pre-funded wallets.
Deploy the token to the Ropsten public test network with truffle migrate and MetaMask, keeping wallet mnemonics in environment variables.
Unbox an existing crowdsale token project and use its development UI (Web3.js) to launch crowdsales and transfer tokens.
Understand that state-changing writes cost ETH in gas while reads are free.
summary.summary: The article is a hands-on tutorial for creating an ERC-20 cryptocurrency token on Ethereum. It walks through installing Truffle, writing a Solidity token contract with OpenZeppelin, and writing JavaScript integration tests run inside truffle develop. It then covers deploying to the Ropsten test network, viewing the token in MetaMask, and unboxing a crowdsale project with a Web3.js development UI. The optional part adds PubNub Functions and ClickSend to send SMS crowdsale announcements; the author notes this needs accounts and API keys.
